projectDescription: COLMAP is a general-purpose Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) pipeline with graphical and command-line interfaces for 3D reconstruction from ordered or unordered image collections.
keyFeatures: Incremental, global, and hierarchical Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines
Multi-View Stereo (MVS) dense 3D reconstruction with patch-match stereo
Feature extraction with SIFT and ALIKED (including LightGlue neural matching)
Graphical User Interface (GUI) for interactive 3D model visualization
Command-line interface with 40+ commands for automated scripting
Python bindings via PyCOLMAP (pip install pycolmap)
Rig/multi-sensor support for stereo cameras, panoramic setups, and AR/VR devices
Multiple camera models (SIMPLE_PINHOLE, PINHOLE, SIMPLE_RADIAL, OPENCV, FULL_OPENCV, etc.)
Vocabulary tree image retrieval for scalable large-dataset matching
Model manipulation tools (aligner, converter, merger, splitter, transformer)
publicApiSurface: PyCOLMAP cost functions for bundle adjustment (requires pyceres)
